title: Loading the pistol
subtitle: Loading and unloading the semi-automatic pistol

lines: This episode teaches the correct method of loading and unloading the semi-automatic pistol.
You must be able to explain the correct procedure for each, step by step.

scenes.heading: Loading the semi-automatic pistol
scenes.caption: Loading, steps 1 to 3, p. 44
lines: Page forty four gives the loading steps, with a photo for each.
Step one: identify a safe direction.
Step two: point the firearm in a safe direction with your finger off the trigger.

lines.text: Now watch steps three to seven on the drawing, starting with the magazine out.
Step three: insert a loaded magazine.
Step four: make sure the magazine is firmly in place.
Step five: grip the slide at the rear between the thumb and index fingers.
Do not cover the ejection port.
Step six: pull the slide all the way to the rear, keeping your finger off the trigger and keeping the muzzle in a safe direction.
Step seven: let the slide go.
The slide should move forward under its own steam.
Do not assist the slide.

scenes.heading: Loading: steps 7 to 9
scenes.caption: Loading, steps 7 to 9, p. 44
lines: Step eight: complete the two-handed grip.
Step nine: the firearm can now be aimed at the target.

scenes.heading: The nine loading steps
scenes.source: Handgun manual, p. 44; formative exam, p. 78
bullets: Safe direction, finger off the trigger
Make sure the magazine is firmly in place
Grip slide at rear, don't cover ejection port
Pull slide to the rear, finger off, safe direction
Let the slide go, don't assist it
The firearm can now be aimed at the target
lines: The formative exam asks you to list the nine correct steps for loading, so here they are together.

lines.text: One, identify a safe direction.
Two, point the firearm in a safe direction, finger off the trigger.
Three, insert a loaded magazine.
Four, make sure the magazine is firmly in place.
Five, grip the slide at the rear between the thumb and index fingers, without covering the ejection port.
Six, pull the slide all the way to the rear, keeping your finger off the trigger and the muzzle in a safe direction.
Seven, let the slide go, without assisting it.
Eight, complete the two-handed grip.
Nine, the firearm can now be aimed at the target.

scenes.heading: Unloading the semi-automatic pistol
scenes.caption: Unloading, steps 1 to 3, p. 45
lines: Page forty five gives the unloading steps.
Step one: when you have completed firing, make sure your finger is off the trigger.
Step two: bring the firearm closer to your body while maintaining a safe direction.

lines.text: Step three: remove the magazine.
Step four: grip the slide at the rear between the thumb and index fingers.
Step five: pull the slide all the way to the rear and, using the slide lock, lock the slide back.
The action of pulling the slide to the rear will eject the live round from the chamber.
Step six: check inside the chamber and down the magazine well.
Maintain a safe direction.
Step seven: let the slide forward and then lower the hammer under control.

scenes.heading: Unloading: steps 6 and 7
scenes.caption: Unloading, steps 6 and 7, p. 45
lines: These photos show step six, checking inside the chamber and down the magazine well.
And step seven, letting the slide forward and then lowering the hammer under control.

scenes.heading: The seven unloading steps
bullets: Completed firing: finger off the trigger
Bring it closer, keep a safe direction
Grip the slide at the rear
Pull slide back, lock it with the slide lock
Check chamber and down the magazine-well
Slide forward, lower hammer under control

lines.text: One, when you've completed firing, make sure your finger is off the trigger.
Two, bring the firearm closer to your body, in a safe direction.
Three, remove the magazine.
Four, grip the slide at the rear between the thumb and index fingers.
Five, pull the slide all the way back and lock it with the slide lock.
Six, check inside the chamber and down the magazine well.
Seven, let the slide forward, then lower the hammer under control.

scenes.question: Loading: you've pulled the slide all the way back. What next?
options: Push the slide forward by hand
Let the slide go, without assisting it
lines: In loading, you've just pulled the slide all the way to the rear.
What do you do next?
reveal: The slide should move forward under its own steam. Do not assist the slide.

scenes.question: Unloading: the slide is locked back. What do you check?
options: Inside the chamber and down the magazine-well
lines: In unloading, the slide is locked back.
What do you check?
reveal: Check inside the chamber and down the magazine well, and maintain a safe direction.

points: Safe direction, finger off the trigger
Loading: magazine in, slide back, let it go
Unloading: magazine out, then the slide
Lock slide back, check chamber and mag-well
Slide forward, lower hammer under control
lines: Both procedures keep a safe direction and your finger off the trigger.
To load, insert the magazine, pull the slide all the way back, and let it go.
To unload, remove the magazine before you work the slide.
Then lock the slide back, and check inside the chamber and down the magazine well.
Finally, let the slide forward and lower the hammer under control.
